simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֶזְקָה (H2393) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חֶזְקָה (chezqâh) means prevailing power First listed occurrence: 2Chr 12 1.

definitions.full: H2393. chezqah [ חֶזְקָה ] noun feminine strength, force (strictly Infinitive form from חזק see Ges § 45 . 1 b) — 1 of urgency of ׳י s hand in prophetic inspiration הַיָד֑ בְּחֶזְקַת Isa 8:11 (compare חָזַק Ezek 3:14 ). 2 of royal power כְּחֶזְקָתוֺ 2Chr 12:1 ; 26:16 (|| חָזַק 26:15 ), Dan 11:2 .
